quirks.condition: The first accepted non-zero event for a key, when its calls fit entirely within the tier quota.
quirks.effect: The key banks calls divided by 10 (integer floor) as extra quota, so that event's quota_left and all later quota arithmetic for the key include the banked amount.

quirks.condition: An accepted event on a key that has already consumed part of its quota (used greater than 0 and below the limit) and whose calls push the key past the limit.
quirks.effect: The event's entire call count is billed at the overage rate; a key with no prior consumption that crosses in one event is billed only on the portion beyond the limit.

quirks.condition: An event billed on tier P whose region, after upper-casing, is BR or IN.
quirks.effect: Overage is priced at 5 cents per 100-call block instead of 6.

quirks.condition: A billed call count whose remainder modulo 100 is exactly 50.
quirks.effect: The number of blocks is the count divided by 100 rounded down; every other remainder rounds up to the next block.

quirks.condition: A later event for a known key carrying tier S when the key is on F, or tier P when the key is on S.
quirks.effect: The event is accepted, the key's tier becomes the new one with its larger quota, and calls already consumed carry over; any other tier change (downgrades, or F directly to P) is rejected TIER echoing the first-seen key spelling.

quirks.condition: A region token of two letters in any mix of case.
quirks.effect: The token is accepted and upper-cased before any region comparison.

quirks.condition: An event whose calls token parses to 0, after the key, calls, tier, and region tokens have passed validation.
quirks.effect: No output line is written and neither the key's state nor the accepted or rejected counters change.

quirks.condition: A key that differs only in letter case from one already seen in the session.
quirks.effect: Consumption, tier, and banked quota accumulate on the same key and output lines echo the first-seen spelling.

quirks.condition: A Q command with more than five tokens.
quirks.effect: The extra tokens are ignored and the event runs normally; FMT rejects echo the key token, or ???????? when it is missing or malformed.

unmapped_families.reason: Two mixed 150+ event corpora exercising every quirk above together with the documented behaviour; no single quirk maps.
